dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ今日のお昼はどうするんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So what are you having for lunch today?"
dialogues.text: "So what are you having for lunch today?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「購買でパンを買って食べようと思います」
dialogues.en: "I think I'm going to buy some sandwiches from the store."
dialogues.text: "I think I'm going to buy some sandwiches from the store."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「俺と同じか……。それなら一緒に行きます
　か？」
dialogues.en: "That's my plan too. Would you like to come with me?"
dialogues.text: "That's my plan too. Would you like to come with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩と一緒では仕方ないが、俺達の横を次々
と学生が追い越していく。
dialogues.en:
As I walked with Moe-sempai, a number of students passed us
by.
dialogues.text:
As I walked with Moe-sempai, a number of students passed us
by.

dialogues.jp: ま、美人と早歩きってのも様になるまい。
dialogues.en: At least I look good, walking with a pretty girl.
dialogues.text: At least I look good, walking with a pretty girl.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「混んでますね？」
dialogues.en: "It's crowded."
dialogues.text: "It's crowded."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね」
dialogues.en: "......Yeah, it is."
dialogues.text: "......Yeah, it is."

dialogues.jp: 売り場の周りは、予想通り大混雑だった。
dialogues.en: As I expected, the store was overcrowded.
dialogues.text: As I expected, the store was overcrowded.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「最後尾はここでいいんでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this the end of the line?"
dialogues.text: "Is this the end of the line?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が俺に確認するように、人ごみの後ろに
並ぼうとする。
dialogues.en: She asked me and tried to get in the line.
dialogues.text: She asked me and tried to get in the line.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、それじゃあ買えませんよ」
dialogues.en:
"You know if you wait in this line, you won't be able to buy
anything."
dialogues.text:
"You know if you wait in this line, you won't be able to buy
anything."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
俺と眞子の視線が合った。互いのやる気を確認
する。この戦場では男も女も関係ない。いるの
は敵か味方か、だけだ。
dialogues.en: "You just wait here. I'll go and get you something."
dialogues.text: "You just wait here. I'll go and get you something."

dialogues.jp:
「萌先輩は待っていてください。俺達が買って
　きますから」
dialogues.en: I rolled up my sleeves and took a deep breath."
dialogues.text: I rolled up my sleeves and took a deep breath."

dialogues.jp: 俺と眞子は、腕まくりして息を整える。
dialogues.en: I have to be aggressive in this situation.
dialogues.text: I have to be aggressive in this situation.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「何がいいです？」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. What do you want to eat?"
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. What do you want to eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……ではどら焼きをお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Well...... can you get me a bean paste waffle?"
dialogues.text: "Well...... can you get me a bean paste waffle?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どら焼きですか？」
dialogues.en: "A bean paste waffle?"
dialogues.text: "A bean paste waffle?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
随分と甘いものを頼むんだな。昼飯は菓子パン
系より、サンドイッチとかコロッケとかが入っ
ているほうがいいと思うんだが。
dialogues.en:
She wants something sweet, huh? I think sandwiches and
burgers are more suitable for lunch...
dialogues.text:
She wants something sweet, huh? I think sandwiches and
burgers are more suitable for lunch...

dialogues.jp: 「他には？」
dialogues.en: "Anything else?"
dialogues.text: "Anything else?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あとは適当にお願いします」
dialogues.en: "I'll leave it up to you."
dialogues.text: "I'll leave it up to you."

dialogues.jp: 眞子と頷きあい、戦地に赴く。
dialogues.en: "All right. See you."
dialogues.text: "All right. See you."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は同時に突撃した。
dialogues.en: I left her and headed toward the war zone.
dialogues.text: I left her and headed toward the war zone.

dialogues.en:
I pushed through the crowd and pulled on people to move
forward.
dialogues.text:
I pushed through the crowd and pulled on people to move
forward.

dialogues.jp: 「ぬうぁぁぁ……かったりぃ……」

人ごみから脱して、思わずホームランを打たれ
た投手のように膝をつきそうになる。
萌先輩の傍らにはすでに眞子が立っていた。
dialogues.en: "Maaaan...... What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "Maaaan...... What a pain......"

dialogues.jp:
２、３人、悲鳴を上げて宙を舞っている男子生
徒がいたが、あれはこいつの仕業か？
dialogues.en:
I escaped from the crowd and kneeled down as if someone hit
a homerun with my pitch.
dialogues.text:
I escaped from the crowd and kneeled down as if someone hit
a homerun with my pitch.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「紳士は女の子に道を譲るものなのよ」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for going through that trouble for me."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for going through that trouble for me."

dialogues.jp:
眞子が、ふっふっふっと勝ち誇ったような笑み
を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: "Here you go. Please choose what you want to eat."
dialogues.text: "Here you go. Please choose what you want to eat."

dialogues.jp:
きっと立ちふさがった奴らは、除雪車に立ち向
かう雪ダルマのように粉砕されたのだろう。
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
「ま、いいや。どうぞ、萌先輩。好きなのを選
　んでください」
dialogues.en:
She bowed at me then took out a bean paste waffle and a
sandwich out of the bag.
dialogues.text:
She bowed at me then took out a bean paste waffle and a
sandwich out of the bag.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
ペコリと頭を下げ、萌先輩が袋に手を入れてど
ら焼きとサンドイッチをとりだす。
dialogues.en: "That's all you want?"
dialogues.text: "That's all you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それだけでいいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Well, I shall go now."
dialogues.text: "Well, I shall go now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yes. Good luck with your exam."
dialogues.text: "Oh, yes. Good luck with your exam."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、私達は失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Thank you very much. I'll see you later."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Thank you very much. I'll see you later."

dialogues.jp:
礼儀正しすぎるぐらいお礼を言って、萌先輩が
眞子に手を引かれ、離れていく。
dialogues.en: She politely thanked me and walked away.
dialogues.text: She politely thanked me and walked away.

dialogues.jp: 俺も勉強でもするか……。
dialogues.en: I guess I should study some more......
dialogues.text: I guess I should study some more......

dialogues.jp:
ひとり分としては少々重めの袋を持って、教室
にもどることにした。
dialogues.en: I headed back to the classroom with a bagful of food.
dialogues.text: I headed back to the classroom with a bagful of food.

dialogues.jp: ◆お昼はどら焼き◆
dialogues.en: ◆Bean paste waffle for lunch◆
dialogues.text: ◆Bean paste waffle for lunch◆

dialogues.jp: せっかくだし、一緒に購買に行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai and I decided to go to the store to get some
lunch together.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai and I decided to go to the store to get some
lunch together.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、人混みに萌先輩は如何にもミスマッチ
である。それで、リクエストを聞いて、俺が買
いに行く事にした。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai doesn't know how to act in the crowd. I asked her
what she wanted, so I could go get the food for her.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai doesn't know how to act in the crowd. I asked her
what she wanted, so I could go get the food for her.

dialogues.jp:
リクエストはどら焼きだった。昼飯にどら焼き
か…。
dialogues.en:
She requested a bean paste waffle. A bean paste waffle for
lunch......?
dialogues.text:
She requested a bean paste waffle. A bean paste waffle for
lunch......?
